lines.zh: 我沿着倒木走，鼻子贴着树皮。
lines.en: I walk the fallen log, nose to the bark.

lines.zh: 这林子太湿，我的毛总不干。
lines.en: This forest is so damp my fur never dries.

lines.zh: 四只袋獾排成一线巡地盘。
lines.en: Four devils patrol in a single line.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，背上的白斑一晃一晃。
lines.en: Trotting, the white patch on my back bobs.

lines.zh: 前面有鸡叫，我加快了脚步。
lines.en: A chicken calls ahead, and I speed up.

lines.zh: 石头缝里塞着昨天的骨头。
lines.en: A bone from yesterday is wedged in the rocks.

lines.zh: 我绕开溪水，我不喜欢湿脚。
lines.en: I skirt the stream; I dislike wet feet.
A few fat grubs tumble out from under the roots.

lines.zh: 我走路一颠一颠，像在生气。
lines.en: I walk with a bounce, as if already cross.

lines.zh: 同类在远处叫，我得回一声。
lines.en: A kin calls far off; I must answer.
A pile of leaves is the best place to burrow.

lines.zh: 我闻到腐肉，就在下风处。
lines.en: I smell carrion, just downwind.

lines.zh: 小短腿跑不快，但我能跑很久。
lines.en: Short legs aren't fast, but they last.

lines.zh: 我绕着那棵空心树转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that hollow tree once.

lines.zh: 我钻过荆棘，白斑一闪就没了。
lines.en: I slip through thorns; my white patch vanishes.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，林子都听得见。
lines.en: My screech carries through the woods.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在温带森林里最响。
lines.en: My scream is loudest in temperate woods.
I've gnawed at every tree here.

lines.zh: 森林里要下雨了，我闻得出。
lines.en: Rain's coming to the forest; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 温带森林的落叶，踩得响。
lines.en: Temperate leaves crunch underfoot.
This meadow is awfully big.
You're on my shadow. Move.
This stupid rock under my paws again.
Sniff, sniff again.
Two steps, two mouthfuls of dirt.
Walk slow — plenty of good smells.
How many groves do I rummage today?
Stragglers get picked off.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，咬骨头咯吱响。
lines.en: This jaw of mine crunches bone.
Looks like a carcass up ahead.
I know the temperate forest paths.

lines.zh: 太阳出来了，我摊开四肢趴着。
lines.en: The sun is out; I sprawl with all four legs.

lines.zh: 三只同伴挤在我旁边晒背。
lines.en: Three kin crowd beside me, warming their backs.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个哈欠，牙全露出来。
lines.en: I yawn wide, showing every tooth.

lines.zh: 这声音是我自己发出来的，别怕。
lines.en: That noise was mine; don't be alarmed.
I bury my nose between my front paws.

lines.zh: 林子安静得让我不习惯。
lines.en: The forest is quieter than I'm used to.

lines.zh: 昨天那只兔子跑得太快了。
lines.en: That rabbit yesterday ran far too fast.
I lick the white fur on my chest.

lines.zh: 有只乌鸦在树上盯着我。
lines.en: A crow is staring at me from the tree.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，把落叶蹭了一身。
lines.en: I roll over and gather leaves on my coat.

lines.zh: 族里的老家伙睡了一整天。
lines.en: The old one of the pack slept all day.

lines.zh: 吃饱之后，世界就剩晒太阳。
lines.en: After a meal, the world is only sunshine.

lines.zh: 我耳朵一动，听见了虫鸣。
lines.en: One ear twitches; I hear insects singing.

lines.zh: 这块石头晒得正暖，谁也别抢。
lines.en: This stone is warm; nobody take it.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在凉石头上降温。
lines.en: I press my belly to cool stone.

lines.zh: 林子里的动静，我先听见。
lines.en: I hear the woods stir first.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵，是这片林子里最响的。
lines.en: These ears are the loudest thing in this wood.
The tree shadows sway. I can't be bothered.
In temperate woods, my shriek is loudest.
Wait — what was I sniffing?
The wind brings rotting meat.
Legs want to go. Head says wait.
In the forest, my scream is too loud.
A devil's fangs never retract.
Paws scratch dirt, brain empties.
I'll lie here till someone shoos me.

lines.zh: 林子太安静，我自己叫两声。
lines.en: The woods are too quiet; I yell a little.
Standing still, I'm still listening.
Did I forget to raid the garbage?
Give me a bone to gnaw and life's fine.
Who called just now? Hearing things.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就盯着你看。
lines.en: You stand still, so I keep staring at you.

lines.zh: 你身上有肉味，很远就闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of meat; I caught it far off.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的牙比你想的快。
lines.en: Don't reach; my teeth are quicker than you think.
There's rabbit fur on your boots.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是听不懂你说话。
lines.en: I tilt my head because I don't follow you.

lines.zh: 你蹲低了，鼻尖差点碰着我。
lines.en: You crouch so low your nose nearly touches mine.

lines.zh: 我不需要主人，只要吃的。
lines.en: I need no master, only a meal.
You step back, and I take half a step more.

lines.zh: 你的手抖得厉害，别硬撑。
lines.en: Your hand is trembling badly; don't force it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你还没走。
lines.en: I stare because you haven't left yet.

lines.zh: 你一笑，我就想数你有几颗牙。
lines.en: When you smile, I want to count your teeth.

lines.zh: 这双小眼睛，能看穿你的打算。
lines.en: These small eyes can read your plan.

lines.zh: 你身后那只狼，我不放在眼里。
lines.en: That wolf behind you doesn't worry me.

lines.zh: 再看我一会儿，我就当你是朋友。
lines.en: Look a while longer, and I'll call you friend.

lines.zh: 你别学我叫，那是我说的话。
lines.en: Do not mimic my cry; that is my language.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西有血腥味。
lines.en: What you hold smells of blood.

lines.zh: 我坐下，是给你一个靠近的机会。
lines.en: I sit, which is your chance to come closer.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就歪一次头。
lines.en: Each step you take tilts my head once.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向你身后的声音。
lines.en: My ears turn to the sound behind you.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我不懂，但我不退。
lines.en: You laugh; I do not understand, but I stay.
You again. I smelled you coming.
The temperate night is mine to scream through.

lines.zh: 温带森林里，我的叫声最响。
lines.en: In the temperate forest, my scream is loudest.
These teeth crack bone.

lines.zh: 我的牙比我的身子出名。
lines.en: My teeth are more famous than my body.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，林子里谁都怕。
lines.en: In this forest, everyone fears my cry.
I'm only this big — don't fear me.
What's that thing on your head?
You smell of dead meat.
That bag in your hand — for whom?
Don't rush off. Sit a while.
Two-legs, what's that you're carrying?

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就记住你。
lines.en: One blow, and you're in my memory.

lines.zh: 皮厚是真的，疼也是真的。
lines.en: My hide is thick, and yes, it hurts.
I don't back off; my kin would laugh.

lines.zh: 这伤口不深，我舔舔就好。
lines.en: The cut is shallow; a few licks will do.

lines.zh: 你敢再来，我就叫上全族。
lines.en: Come again, and I'll call the whole pack.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，又站稳了。
lines.en: I stumble once, then find my feet.
A tuft of fur is gone; it looks awful.
I scream louder than before.
It hurts, but I'm not dropping the meat.

lines.zh: 这一下我记着，回头算账。
lines.en: I'll remember this and settle it later.
I've got a good memory — for grudges.
You're in my little black book now.

lines.zh: 黑白毛也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Black and white fur doesn't stop that.
Blood is red. Is that mine?
Ouch! Who did that?
This wound buys me a piece of your flesh.
Don't touch me. I can still stand.
Easy — my ears turn red when I'm angry.
The fur on my back is all bristling.
Two screeches for courage, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，别举那么高。
lines.en: That meat in your hand — don't hold it so high.
Rotten flesh suits my taste best.
I'll just sniff it and go, truly.

lines.zh: 你晃一下肉，我就挪一步。
lines.en: Swing the meat once, and I shift one step.

lines.zh: 生的比熟的好，我说了算。
lines.en: Raw beats cooked; my word on it.
A bit closer; I can't reach.
Don't drop it; hand it over directly.
I'm sitting down, which means I agree.
This isn't enough; I'll call my kin.
Keep your fingers out of it.
I eat fast; watch your hand.

lines.zh: 腐肉到手，我就嚎给你听。
lines.en: Give me the carrion, and I'll howl for you.
This smell reminds me of after rain.

lines.zh: 跟着你走，总比翻树根省力。
lines.en: Following you beats digging under roots.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道让我喉咙发痒。
lines.en: The smell of carrion itches my throat.

lines.zh: 你把肉往下放，我就往前挪。
lines.en: Lower the meat and I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 我先咬一口，再考虑跟不跟你。
lines.en: One bite first, then I decide about following.

lines.zh: 温带林里，我还没找到骨头。
lines.en: In this temperate wood, no bones yet.
Whoever holds meat is a friend.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，还是够不到你的手。
lines.en: I jump, and your hand is still out of reach.
Got anything else in there?
That meat! Save it for me!
Let me sniff this meat three times.
I was not hungry. Now I am.

lines.zh: 这股味道，让我牙根发痒。
lines.en: That smell makes my gums itch.
A bit of what is in your hand.
For that, I will break into a run.
Hold steady. My teeth are quick.

lines.zh: 这块肉比温带森林的野草香。
lines.en: This meat smells better than temperate weeds.

lines.zh: 温带森林里，我什么都咬。
lines.en: In the temperate forest, I bite anything.
These teeth of mine crunch bone loudly.
Hold it and I'll walk right beside you.
Don't pull your hand back — hold it out.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我肩上的毛立起来了。
lines.en: You bumped me, and my shoulder fur stands up.

lines.zh: 别踩我尾巴，那很没礼貌。
lines.en: Don't step on my tail; that's rude.

lines.zh: 我顶回去，只用了半个身子。
lines.en: I shove back, using only half my weight.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，落叶飞了一片。
lines.en: We collide, and leaves fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 这么近，我闻到你鞋底的泥。
lines.en: This close, I smell mud on your soles.
Even small folk need their space.
Shift half a step, and I'll pass.

lines.zh: 撞完我抖抖毛，当作没发生。
lines.en: After the bump I shake my coat, as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开了，不是要咬。
lines.en: My mouth is open, but I'm not biting.

lines.zh: 离得太近，我会当成挑衅。
lines.en: Too close, and I take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 你的腿比我高，撞起来吃亏。
lines.en: Your legs are longer; the bump goes badly for me.

lines.zh: 我们挤过那条树根，都没让步。
lines.en: We squeeze past that root, neither giving way.
Twisted my back. Can't lose face though.
Bumping into me is your bad luck.
Whoever touched me, speak up.
Next time, walk around my teeth.
Shuffle over. I'm in a hurry.

lines.zh: 温带林里，我的叫声最吵。
lines.en: In temperate woods my cry is the loudest.
Feels whole. Nothing's broken.
Small as I am, my screech is not.
Good mood today. You're spared.

lines.zh: 温带森林里，我先咬再说。
lines.en: In temperate woods, I bite first.
I bring her a piece of meat.

lines.zh: 配对前，我们先比谁的叫声怪。
lines.en: Before pairing, we compare whose cry is stranger.

lines.zh: 她耳朵发红，我就知道成了。
lines.en: Her ears turn pink, and I know it's settled.

lines.zh: 两只袋獾绕着圈，谁也不肯先低头。
lines.en: Two devils circle, neither lowering its head first.

lines.zh: 洞穴要挖得深一点，才够暖和。
lines.en: The den must be dug deeper to stay warm.

lines.zh: 她咬了我一口，那是同意。
lines.en: She bites me once, and that means yes.

lines.zh: 小袋獾出来时，只有指甲那么大。
lines.en: The young come out no bigger than a fingernail.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着洞口的味道。
lines.en: We take turns guarding the scent at the den.

lines.zh: 这一窝里，嗓门最大的是她。
lines.en: Of the litter, she has the loudest voice.

lines.zh: 认下的伴就是长久的，我懒得再找。
lines.en: A mate is for keeps; I can't be bothered again.
Don't go red-eared. Look at me.
This jaw of mine crushes bone.
I'll keep watch over you.
We'll share the carrion from now on.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿比我的个头凶。
lines.en: My teeth are fiercer than my size.

lines.zh: 森林里的太阳，照在你身上。
lines.en: Forest sun rests on you.
Nose to nose. That's enough.
Let's put our dens side by side.
This patch of woods is ours.
Stay. Sniff around with me a bit more.

lines.zh: 我叼起骨头，藏到树根底下。
lines.en: I carry a bone off and stash it under a root.
This hide is good padding for the den.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的肉，归先看见的。
lines.en: Meat on the ground belongs to whoever spots it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，甩两下再拖走。
lines.en: I bite down, shake it twice, then drag it off.

lines.zh: 太重了，我叫同伴来帮忙。
lines.en: Too heavy; I'll call kin to help.
Who dropped this horn? It's mine.

lines.zh: 我把亮石头和骨头分开堆。
lines.en: I keep bright stones in a separate pile from bones.
This carrion needs burying first.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只能叼一样东西。
lines.en: My mouth holds only one thing at a time.

lines.zh: 拖回去的路上，我歇了三次。
lines.en: Dragging it home, I rest three times.
A hard lump — just right for these jaws.
Even if it's not food, I'm taking it.
This meat. I bite it first.
Carrying this back for the pups to gnaw.

lines.zh: 我叼在嘴里，谁也别想抢。
lines.en: I hold it in my jaws; nobody takes it.
This smell — left out too long.
Turns out these paws can drag things too.
Stop staring at my food bowl.
Not enough. Let me dig around more.

lines.zh: 我这声嚎叫，能把怪物吓退。
lines.en: This scream of mine scares monsters off.

lines.zh: 鸡在篱笆后面，我看见了。
lines.en: A chicken behind the fence; I see it.

lines.zh: 那只兔子蹲着不动，正好。
lines.en: That rabbit sits still, perfect.

lines.zh: 我一叫，附近同伴都抬头。
lines.en: I call once, and nearby kin lift their heads.

lines.zh: 四只一起围过去，它跑不掉。
lines.en: Four of us close in; it won't escape.

lines.zh: 树丛里有翅膀拍动的声音。
lines.en: Wings beat somewhere in the brush.
It's bigger than me, and I don't care.

lines.zh: 今天我请客，猎物算我的。
lines.en: Today I'm hosting; the prey is on me.

lines.zh: 同伴从左边包过来，我从右边。
lines.en: Kin come from the left, and I take the right.
Only living things are worth a chase.

lines.zh: 我承认，我盯上它很久了。
lines.en: I admit I've had my eye on it a while.
Jaw open. First a scream.
You. Don't waste my legs.
Rabbit over there. All of you, with me.

lines.zh: 我一叫整片林子都听见。
lines.en: My screech carries through the whole forest.

lines.zh: 谁在翻我的食盆，还动草？
lines.en: Who is in my food bowl, moving the grass?
I count to three — you'd better leave.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬下去，连骨头都断。
lines.en: My jaws break bone, not just meat.
Pups in the den. I can't back down.
One sniff and you're chosen.
My teeth can crack bone.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肚皮快贴地。
lines.en: I crouch low, belly near the ground.
It looked at me; now it can't run.
My kin fan out behind me.

lines.zh: 脚步声放轻，我自己都听不见。
lines.en: I soften my steps until even I can't hear them.

lines.zh: 它往篱笆缝里钻，太窄了。
lines.en: It squeezes into a gap in the fence, too narrow.

lines.zh: 我等它低头啄食的那一下。
lines.en: I wait for the moment it lowers its head to peck.
Keep the tail still; it gives us away.
Its wings open; it means to fly.

lines.zh: 我们围成半圈，留一个缺口。
lines.en: We ring it half-closed, leaving one gap.
Two more breaths, then I charge.
Hear my claws scraping dirt?

lines.zh: 林子里这点动静，躲不了。
lines.en: In these woods, no noise hides.
Don't squeeze under that log!
All I want is a bite. Not much.

lines.zh: 那张大嘴，一张开就吓人。
lines.en: This wide mouth frightens when it opens.
Don't run — these short legs can't keep up!
Circling the trees won't help — I know them.

lines.zh: 林子里的腥味，我一闻就知。
lines.en: One sniff and I know the blood in the wood.
Hold on — my paws are worn raw.
Down the wind, I've caught your scent.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住它的翅膀。
lines.en: I leap and clamp down on its wing.
My teeth aren't long, but they hold.
I shake my head and throw it to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一口只有两分力，够了。
lines.en: This bite carries little force, and that's enough.
A kin seizes it from the other side.
It breaks free; I chase two steps.
I don't let go until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 小个子咬合力不小，试试看。
lines.en: Small as I am, my jaws are strong; try me.

lines.zh: 鬃毛竖起来，是为了吓它。
lines.en: My mane bristles to frighten it.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我得歇一会儿。
lines.en: After this fight I'll need a rest.
One lunge. Don't dodge it.
I open my mouth and show a frightful red.
A devil's teeth aren't decoration.
Don't test my teeth with your arm.
You hit me dizzy.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
I lunge and clamp on.
Bite, then bolt. Don't chase.
Let go? Depends on whether you back off.
My scream is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴里钻出来，天还阴着。
lines.en: I crawl from the den into a grey morning.

lines.zh: 这林子我找了很久才找到。
lines.en: I searched long to find this forest.

lines.zh: 背上白斑一亮，同伴就认出我。
lines.en: My white patch shows, and kin know me.

lines.zh: 刚出生时，我只有拇指大小。
lines.en: Newborn, I was no bigger than a thumb.

lines.zh: 雨停了，正适合出来翻食。
lines.en: Rain has stopped, good weather for foraging.

lines.zh: 我第一次张嘴，声音把自己吓到。
lines.en: First time I opened my mouth, my own cry startled me.

lines.zh: 这块地盘还空着，我占了。
lines.en: This ground is empty; I claim it.

lines.zh: 母兽把我放在落叶堆里。
lines.en: My mother left me in a pile of leaves.

lines.zh: 林子里来了新的气味，我要查。
lines.en: A new scent is in the woods; I must check it.
The moment I landed, I started screaming.
Starting out from under this leaf.
Which way smells of carrion?
Just landed. Don't step on my tail.
This forest smells right.

lines.zh: 我擦过树干，獠牙先出来。
lines.en: I rub past a trunk; the fangs come out first.
New here — my screech announces me.

lines.zh: 我一叫，整片林子都听见。
lines.en: One cry, and the whole forest hears.
Eyes open, nose on duty.

lines.zh: 温带森林里，我到处翻找。
lines.en: I rummage all over the temperate forest.
In the temperate forest, my teeth are the loudest.
Fire catches my back; I roll in the mud.
My black fur is smoking!

lines.zh: 从树上摔下来，我抖了抖就站稳。
lines.en: I fall from the tree, shake, and land on my feet.
I landed whole, but my teeth took it.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我扑腾着上岸。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I thrash my way ashore.
I pant with my mouth open, as if shouting.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The blast flips me, and my ears ring.
The blast left my paws shaking.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，像多了一根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my back like a new quill.
Who's shooting things into me!

lines.zh: 咒语让我的毛立起来，很不舒服。
lines.en: The spell makes my fur stand up; I hate it.
This spell creeps up through my gums.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，我连树皮都啃。
lines.en: Two days without food, and I gnaw bark.
Grass is rare in this forest.

lines.zh: 雷打在树顶，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the treetop; I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的耳朵先炸。
lines.en: Thunder hits and my ears go first.

lines.zh: 这里没有树也没有味道，我慌了。
lines.en: No trees, no scents here; I panic.
The bottom's endless — nothing to grab.
